title: Per-state driver-license-number pattern gazetteer
description: Structural patterns (anchored regex + length_range + alphabet + sample + per-row legal posture / attestation) for all 51 jurisdictions (50 states + DC). Promoted from src/resecta_data/gazetteers/dl_patterns/sources/dl_patterns_candidates.json after candidates-file review. License posture is one of state-work / permissive-OSS-MIT / state-statute-anchored / aamva-envelope (no needs-legal-review posture). 11 envelope rows ship the canonical AAMVA M1 envelope `^[A-Z0-9]{8,13}$` with state-format claim retracted (`state_format_claimed: false`); 3 statute-anchored rows (NC, TN, UT) ship tight per-state regex anchored to UVC-template state-statute primary publication at the top attestation rank; remaining 37 rows (11 state-work + 26 permissive-OSS-MIT) ship per-state regex with attestation at the lower ranks. The `_advisory_note` at the file root is a WA specimen-image audit (no separate audit deliverable).

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the shape changes in a way the Swift decoder must observe.

generated_date.description: Deterministic ISO date lifted verbatim from the candidates JSON. Wall-clock content is banned from payloads.

seed.description: PRNG seed recorded for reproducibility. Unused by this builder (deterministic transcription); preserved for uniformity across artifacts.

_advisory_note.description: Advisory-only WA specimen-image audit + posture-distribution + closed-flag summary. Ships as a JSON-only advisory inside this artifact (no separate audit deliverable). Carried through to the shipping artifact at build time.

rows.description: Per-state pattern rows in ascending state_code order. Fixed at 51 (50 states + DC).

state_code.description: Closed enum: 50 USPS state codes + DC.

patterns.description: One or more anchored regex strings describing the DL-number shape. Unions appear as a single string with `|` alternation. For envelope rows the array is locked to `["^[A-Z0-9]{8,13}$"]` by the `aamva-envelope` conditional gate.

length_range.description: Character-count band post display-punctuation strip (Resecta normalizes hyphens / spaces before matching).

alphabet.description: Human description of the character class (e.g. `numeric`, `alpha-prefixed`, `A-Z0-9`).

sample.description: Synthetic example matching the row's pattern; not real PII.

source_url.description: Canonical publisher URL for the per-state primary source, OR — for envelope rows — an internal citation recording the source rationale (no Skyhigh / MyShn / NTSI aggregator citations on the four aggregator-retired envelope rows).

source_verified_date.description: ISO date the source was last verified. Initially attested rows: 2026-04-22; promoted/tightened rows: 2026-04-23; envelope rows: adopted 2026-04-25; statute-anchored rows: re-verified 2026-04-26.

license_posture.description: Per-row legal posture (4-value closed enum). `needs-legal-review` has been retired; every row now resolves to one of the four listed postures.

license_notes.description: Prose license rationale, source citations, and any caveats. For envelope rows: the four aggregator-retired rows must state that their aggregator lineage was retired; the remaining envelope rows carry a substitute rationale instead. Must NOT cite Skyhigh / MyShn / NTSI.

attestation.description: Attestation strength (ranks 1–7) plus the `aamva-envelope` marker for the M1 substitution rows.

state_format_claimed.description: Whether the row claims a per-state format. False on envelope rows (state-format claim retracted); true on all other rows.

historical_variants.description: Format-transition events that sit inside the active valid-DL renewal window (typically ~5–10 years). Empty / absent for rows with no recent transition or for envelope rows (per-state pattern not claimed). Mirrors the passport_patterns `recent_format_changes` shape.

pii_severity.description: Elevated PII-severity flag for Soundex / Gallian-style name-or-DOB-encoded DL formats. Optional; informational-only (a HIPAA Safe Harbor consideration). Live: FL, IL, MD, MI, WI; legacy still in circulation: MN pre-2004, NH pre-2017, WA legacy-PIC.

dln_overlap_note.description: SSN/DLN ambiguity note. Permitted only on AR/HI/ID/LA/MS rows (5 jurisdictions with legacy 9-digit DL visually indistinguishable from SSN). Notes two-way ambiguity between SSN and DLN only.
